claim_boundary: Real disposable personal income is an inflation-adjusted after-tax household-resource aggregate, not a Bitcoin predictor. A strictly accelerating year-over-year growth rate may proxy improving risk-bearing capacity, while fiscal transfers, savings behavior and monetary-policy reactions can reverse the sign. This supports one audit only.

primary_sources.title: Real Disposable Personal Income
primary_sources.publisher: U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis via FRED
primary_sources.use: Official monthly seasonally adjusted annual-rate real disposable personal income identity and free present-vintage CSV source.

primary_sources.title: Disposable Personal Income

independence_and_duplicate_boundary.distinct_from_closed_retail_and_output: DSPIC96 measures inflation-adjusted after-tax household resources. RRSFS measured retail demand and INDPRO measured production output; neither closed family can be reopened or combined with this one.
independence_and_duplicate_boundary.distinct_from_closed_inflation: The feature uses the adjacent change in real-income year-over-year growth, not CPI inflation direction. CPIAUCSL remains permanently closed.
independence_and_duplicate_boundary.prohibited_rescue: Do not add transfers, savings, consumption, payrolls, smoothing, levels, alternate lags, thresholds, direction inversion or another factor after access.

adversarial_prior: Present-vintage BEA revisions do not reproduce original release vintages.
Pandemic fiscal transfers can dominate adjacent year-over-year growth changes.
Income growth can be saved rather than allocated to risk assets.
Strong household resources can delay monetary easing or arrive after markets already moved.
A long-cash rule can reduce drawdown only by forfeiting upside.
stop_conditions: Stop DATA_REJECT before hypothesis or BTC access on any source, lattice or support failure.
If the source gate passes, freeze exactly one hypothesis and economic manifest before BTC outcomes.
Stop NO_CANDIDATE on any economic, drawdown, Calmar, upside, breadth, concentration or determinism failure.
Do not open post-2024 outcomes; a historical pass remains REPORTED_NOT_ACTIVATED.
